verdict.rationale: Finix documents platform monetization broadly — configurable fee schemas, fee customizations (international charges, volume discounts, per-payment-method fees), and automated reports covering fees/transactions/disputes — which supports setting a 'sell rate' and viewing some cost data (finix-docs-11, finix-docs-25, finix-docs-24, finix-docs-26). However, there is no explicit documentation of a stated 'buy rate' from Finix or interchange-level cost breakdowns needed to precisely manage spread. Missing for 10: documented buy rate/cost basis from Finix, explicit interchange-level fee visibility, and independent confirmation of spread management in practice.
